title: XVX-016 GUNDAM AERIAL
summary: This is my first FM kit every and it is just purely awesome. While the frame can't be compared to a normal MG kit, especially the 2.0 lineup, it holds itself pretty good with many joints and articulation. Even the feet has three articulation points!
body: This is my first FM kit every and it is just purely awesome. While the frame can't be compared to a normal MG kit, especially the 2.0 lineup, it holds itself pretty good with many joints and articulation. Even the feet has three articulation points!

The armor design is, as usual, Bandai's best. However, I feel that the plastic quality is not their normal level. It is easy to get scratch and one of the part even broke when I cut it off runner (shield bit).
And the worst thing about this model kit is the hand which couldn't hold the gun tightly.
As a warning, the shoulder joint seems weak and could be broken at times (I have seen people breaking it) so be careful when you are playing with poses.
10/10 would buy a MG or even MGEX just because I really love their Aerial kit design
